# GreyLeads

> GreyLeads (GreyLeads Solutions Pvt Ltd) is a full-service digital marketing agency in Bellandur, Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, also serving Chennai and metro India. One senior team builds websites and apps, runs Google, Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube ads, handles SEO and AEO (answer engine optimisation), creates ad creative and brand identities, and automates WhatsApp, email and CRM follow-ups. We report on leads, sales and cost per customer.

## Key facts

- Name: GreyLeads (legal name: GreyLeads Solutions Pvt Ltd)
- Type: Digital marketing agency
- Address: RMZ Ecoworld, Building 6A, Outer Ring Road, Adarsh Palm Retreat Villas, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India
- Cities served: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune and the rest of India. We meet Chennai clients in person in Chennai.
- Languages: English, Tamil, Kannada, Hindi
- Founder and CEO: John Jayaseelan
- Leadership: Deepak (Chief Financial Officer), Evangeline (Marketing Head), Mani Kandan (Chief Technical Officer)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 70105 52833
- Email: contact@greyleads.in
- Website: https://greyleads.in
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/d4kmFSBrnKHxZwPz8
- Visits: by appointment
- Pricing: marketing retainers start from ₹40,000 a month; websites and apps are quoted as fixed-price projects after a discovery call
- Contracts: a three-month starting period for marketing, then month to month
- Ownership: clients own their website, app code, ad accounts, creatives and data from day one

## Services

- [Lead generation](https://greyleads.in/lead-generation): offers, landing pages, Meta, Google, LinkedIn and YouTube lead campaigns, lead scoring, CRM and instant WhatsApp follow-up
- [Website design and development](https://greyleads.in/websites): fast, mobile-first websites and e-commerce built to convert visitors into enquiries
- [Mobile app development](https://greyleads.in/apps): iOS, Android and web apps, cross-platform or native
- [SEO and AEO](https://greyleads.in/seo-aeo): technical and local SEO, Google Business Profile, content, and visibility in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI results
- [Performance marketing](https://greyleads.in/performance-marketing): Meta, Google Search, YouTube and LinkedIn ads managed for leads and sales
- [Creative ads](https://greyleads.in/creative-ads): reels, stories, carousels, static and video ads, tested every week
- [Branding and social media](https://greyleads.in/branding): brand identity, guidelines and social media management
- [Marketing automation](https://greyleads.in/automation): CRM setup, WhatsApp Business API, email sequences and sales alerts

## Case studies

- [IAcharya](https://greyleads.in/work/iacharya): solar training. SEO and ad campaigns. Page 1 on Google within six months and 150+ course leads every month.
- [Greyweave](https://greyleads.in/work/greyweave): handcrafted rugs. SEO and creative. A brand-new website reached page 1 on Google for high-volume keywords in six months.
- [Pix.city](https://greyleads.in/work/pixcity): local marketing, France. Targeted, 100% verified decision-maker data across France and Europe.
- [Quadrate](https://greyleads.in/work/quadrate): translation services. Targeted, 100% verified data that gave the sales team better response.
- [SOLIZE](https://greyleads.in/work/solize): digital engineering and manufacturing. LinkedIn ad campaigns and creative to reach engineering and industry professionals.
- [Jona's Cafe](https://greyleads.in/work/jonas-cafe): cafe and food. Mobile app rebuilt from scratch for iOS and Android, with AI features, automation and a lightweight design, for launch on the Play Store and App Store.
- [All work](https://greyleads.in/work)
